## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the package or application affected.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm sync:check`
- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm pack:check` when a published package changed

## Release

- [ ] I added a changeset for a user-visible published-package change.
- [ ] No changeset is required because this change affects only documentation, tests, examples, or
      private applications.
- [ ] I reviewed generated files and upstream attribution when synchronized source changed.
